suggestions: I'm grateful for the office lift finally working again after a week of taking the stairs to the ninth floor.
I'm thankful for a client approving the scope without three rounds of "just one more small change."
I'm grateful for leftover rendang reheating better than it did the first night it was cooked.
I'm thankful for the twenty minutes after Maghrib when nobody expects a reply from me.
I'm grateful for a junior dev catching a bug in my PR before it hit staging.
I'm thankful for the LRT actually arriving on time the one day I was already running late.
I'm grateful for my dad texting "jalan selamat" before every long drive, every single time.
I'm thankful for a Friday where the stand-up ran five minutes instead of fifty.
I'm grateful for the mamak getting my kurang manis right without me having to ask twice.
I'm thankful for a bug report that turned out to be a one-line fix instead of a lost weekend.
I'm grateful for the aunty next door sending over extra kuih just because she made too much.
I'm thankful for finding parking right in front of the clinic on the one day I was already late.
I'm grateful for a payslip landing a day early, right when the car instalment was due.
I'm thankful for the breeze through the window before the heat and the Slack notifications start.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of nitpicking semicolons.
